    "body": "Replaced inline indexing within git hooks with a queue-and-daemon model where hooks only write flag files (~10ms enqueue cost) and a launchd daemon processes them asynchronously. This naturally debounces bursty activity (e.g., multi-commit pulls) and keeps hook latency sub-10ms since enqueueing doesn't load the ORT. Post-merge hooks were added to catch fast-forward pulls that were previously being skipped entirely (katulong had accumulated 133 unindexed commits as evidence). parsed.title: Shifted from synchronous hook-based indexing to push-based daemon queue pattern
parsed.body: Replaced inline indexing within git hooks with a queue-and-daemon model where hooks only write flag files (~10ms enqueue cost) and a launchd daemon processes them asynchronously. This naturally debounces bursty activity (e.g., multi-commit pulls) and keeps hook latency sub-10ms since enqueueing doesn't load the ORT. Post-merge hooks were added to catch fast-forward pulls that were previously being skipped entirely (katulong had accumulated 133 unindexed commits as evidence). parsed.title: Replace fragile string parsing with structured connection_count field
parsed.body: The original implementation parsed connection status from string sentinels like 'no edges', which was fragile and error-prone across multiple code paths (CLI heal, status display). By introducing a dedicated connection_count field in TunnelInfo, the code gains type safety and eliminates sentinel-based parsing. This reduces cognitive load and prevents bugs from string format changes.

parsed.title: Fix tunnel recovery: KeepAlive must be unconditional to restart after graceful shutdown
parsed.body: Setting KeepAlive=false with SuccessfulExit=false prevented launchd from restarting cloudflared after SIGTERM (exit 0). The heal command couldn't recover tunnels that were loaded in launchd but had no running process. By changing to unconditional KeepAlive=true, gracefully shutdown tunnels are now automatically restarted, and heal correctly identifies and restarts these zombie launchd entries.

parsed.title: Default to healthy state when tunnel health data is missing from API
parsed.body: Rather than failing closed (defaulting to unhealthy), the heal command defaults to healthy when API data is unavailable. This guards against false positives when the CF API is unreachable and prevents unnecessary tunnel restarts. The implementation also bails early if tunnel_info is empty and skips unreached accounts entirely.

parsed.title: Extract shared sync preamble helper to reduce duplication between CLI commands
parsed.body: Both cli_sync and cli_heal commands performed identical initial setup work (loading config, calling sync API, handling errors). Extracting load_sync_result() as a shared helper eliminates duplication and ensures consistent error handling across multiple entry points. This improves maintainability and reduces the likelihood of sync-related logic diverging.
